headline: European Union proposes sweeping new sanctions targeting Russian banks crypto platforms and sports events
label: NEWS
caption:
The European Commission has proposed a major new sanctions package against Russia targeting banks, crypto platforms, and sporting events 🇪🇺

According to the European Commission, the new proposals include removing 60 banks from the SWIFT messaging system and banning Russian teams and athletes from competing under their flag at European Union events.

Commission chief Ursula von der Leyen stated that the measures aim to increase economic pressure and curb Russian financing of the war in Ukraine.

The proposals also include visa bans for Russian ex combatants and restrictions on financial flows from Russian sponsors to sports and cultural associations based in the European Union.
